title: Nearly Minimax Rates for Functional Estimation Under Rough Random Design
abstract: A Lean development of upper and local lower minimax bounds for nonlinear functionals of conditional means under bounded, rough random design. The generic theorem covers the root-n regime and the subcritical regime with its density-dependent stretched-exponential correction, logarithmic upper and lower factors, and a one-quarter minimax probability lower bound. The substantive development also contains projection, polynomial-estimator, Poisson reduction, lattice-prior, application, and causal-identification results. The selected Comparator surface is the generic theorem's two parts. The remaining logarithmic gap is unresolved.
